svg.title: Happy birthday, Trap — Arcade's graffiti mural
svg.desc: 140 approved hand-painted covers by 140 people. Each painting includes its original birthday wish in its description.
svg.metadata: Snapshot 8293ad0adab0fd5a. Saved 2026-11-10T14:24:38.001Z. Original vector strokes; no external assets.

g.title: Aura
g.desc: Happiest birthday, pretty! 🩷 Thank you for being such a good friend to me. You're such a sweet, kind-hearted and lovely soul 𖹭 I wish nothing but the greatest things and endless happiness in the world for u, always. Be happy, stay happy, my pretty girl. Keep shining, slaying and being the brightest stargirl who brings happiness and positive vibes to everyone around u. 😘

g.title: BD0
g.desc: Happiest birthdayyyy my sweet girl🦢🎂✨ The girl who is so warm, authentic, unique and so close to my heart🪄💗 I hope this new year bring you endless happiness, beautiful surprises, loveliest memories, and all the little things that make your heart smile💗🫧🧸 You deserve all the love, all the pretty little moments, and everything your heart wishes for 🦢🎀💞 I'm so happy to have you in my life, and I hope you never forget how special and loved you are🫧🪷 Please stay your adorable self forever, because the world needs more people like youuu. Sending you the biggest love everrr🦩🎀💞💞💞💞

g.title: Fyy
g.desc: Trap, even though we don't know each other that well, I can tell that you're such a kind and thoughtful person. Thank you for always being around and for continuously helping Arcade, especially Fear and Esthell. Your time, effort, and willingness to help never go unnoticed, and I'm sure your presence means more than you realise. for all the good things you've done. May Allah protect your heart, grant you good health, and fill your days with barakah. I hope life treats you gently, and may you always be surrounded by people who appreciate your kindness as much as you deserve. جزاكِ اللهُ خيرًا

g.title: who_dah
g.desc: Happy Birthday Prettyyy!! May your dreams come true and you have a wonderful life ahead <3

g.title: hiffuu
g.desc: Happy birthday cutie 💞 May your life always be free from hurdles and you get everything you want ❣️ Stay happy and healthy always 🫶

g.title: Dixie
g.desc: Happy birthday Trap aka ISirena! Your generosity never goes unnoticed. From sacrificing to sponsor giveaways to keeping the GC peaceful, you bring happiness to people in your own way. May all the kindness you spread return to you tenfold. Wishing you endless happiness, success, and barakah. Stay blessed!
